interpretation_rules: 111 identities include individual currents, families, systems and a segment; they are not equivalent physical measurement targets.

463 width samples across14 owners,15 regional speed summaries for one owner, and6 seasonal core-velocity estimates across3 owners remain unchanged.
The new10 records across8 owners are author-selected characteristic map values from Richardson and Walsh1986, not pooled instantaneous-speed statistics or uniformly weighted whole-current means.

Characteristic mean-vector speed, seasonal velocity variation and annual/semiannual harmonic amplitudes are separate operators. Preserve the printed harmonic definition0.5*sqrt(A_x^2+A_y^2); do not rename it RMS.
The NECC characteristic5-10cm/s interval is not an annual envelope. Three SEC source rows remain separate and are not averaged.
Phases, monthly series, annual extrema, fixed observation depth and numerical uncertainty remain unknown. No reconstructed monthly animation is admitted.
The historical ship-drift population spans1875-1976 and is weighted toward1920-1940; Table1 supplies characteristic summaries, not10 independent observations.
15 older speed summaries,6 core estimates,187 widths,13 length owners,83 reference routes and all prior scientific collection rows are preserved. The existing NECC core scene remains separate.

Experimental regional model/product paths, numerical sensitivity and fixed-meridian spans remain distinct from physical whole-current lengths, flow-normal widths, annual ranges and measurement uncertainty.
Prior source-specific operator and boundary qualifications remain recorded in checkpointv20 and its cited source contracts. This checkpoint supersedes their historical aggregate counts.
